technique_name: Explain the concept of circadian rhythm.
description: Circadian rhythm is the internal 24-hour clock of the body that regulates many physiological processes, such as sleep–wake cycles. Circadian rhythm is controlled by the hypothalamus in the brain, and is based on the daily changes in light and darkness levels as well as several hormones that are released at different points throughout the day.
